verdict.rationale: Stripe Treasury creates a Transaction object as a ledger entry for every movement of funds. The docs position these objects for building account activity feeds and reconciliation, with webhook events on creation and typed flow objects such as ReceivedDebit and OutboundPayment. That supports the core of a buildable transaction feed with object-level identifiers. Missing for 10: documented counterparty details, rail-specific metadata fields (ACH/wire/RTP specifics), explicit stable-identifier guarantees, merchant/category enrichment, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of data richness.
